description: Runs Mondays at 07:00 UK time. Collects published, Live posts from HPUK News and Other News first published in the previous week (Monday 00:00 to Monday 00:00 UK time) with Include in Weekly Roundup set, leaves out audience-targeted posts, and sends each enabled Comms Distribution port a digest of the posts tagged for that port or All ports, by email from the Communications mailbox and to its Teams channel. Ports with no posts get nothing. Each Comms Distribution row and channel (key port#row ID) is reserved in the Delivery Log before it is sent, at most once a week; a re-run sends only rows logged as Failed, claimed with an ETag check so two runs can't both retry one. Runs one at a time. Each row is read again just before sending: a row switched off during the run is skipped and reported. DispatchEnabled is read when a run starts. Does nothing while DispatchEnabled is No. A Comms Distribution row with Port All ports is a company-wide destination and receives every post. With RoundupGroupByTheme = Yes the digest is grouped under the strategy themes (Our People, Our Business, Our Environment, One TEAM), then Other news.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
These roundup deliveries did not complete:

@{join(variables('Failures'), '
')}

A row logged as Reconcile may or may not have arrived: check with the recipient. If it didn't arrive, set the row's Delivery status to Failed and resubmit this run. Only Failed rows are ever retried. A row still Reserved was sent but not logged: set it to Sent.

Destinations already sent for this week are always skipped.

Catch_run_failed.description: Run-level failure alert: any error in Scope_Main that no step handled.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The flow @{workflow()?['tags']?['flowDisplayName']} stopped with an error it did not handle, so some of its work may not have been done. Nothing has been retried.

Run: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']} (started @{workflow()?['run']?['startTime']})

    @{join(body('Select_failed_steps'), '')}

Open the run, find the failed step and its raw output, fix the cause, then resubmit the run or deal with the items by hand. Check for partial changes first (see Stopping and recovery in the deployment guide).
